name: Center-Out Split Wipe
easing: divider EASE.inOut f0-14; panel reveal clip grows outward from the center f10-34; text f30-48
bestFor: Before/after, paper vs production, two states of one thing.
notSuitable: Items that need to arrive separately.
keyframeTable: divider done; panels 25% revealed from center
script: f0-14: cream divider line draws top to bottom at x=960.
f10-34: left panel unrolls leftward and right panel rightward from the divider.
f30-48: icons are visible; labels wipe in.
